title: Circuitry
subtitle: A circuits workbook
summary: For someone who can solder but can't yet design. Ten trunk lessons build from Ohm's law, voltage dividers and wire losses through RC filters, diodes and op-amps to finding the fault in a dead board with a multimeter. The wires in every circuit are coloured by their voltage, so you can watch a capacitor fill or a transistor switch on. Two branches open up a Fuzz Face and a Tube Screamer, or size an off-grid solar system from the panel down.
